Name: Seasonal Cat
Author: WithoutGravitas
Description:
This mod replaces your cat with a magical kitty that changes form with the seasons. The seasonal cat has specific sprites and colors for Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter, to add to the seasonal charm of your farm. It is less a cat, and more a nature spirit that looks like a cat, so it has things like flowers on its tail and cute pointed ears.

The mod uses ContentPatcher so you don't need to mess with .xnb files.

[code][size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][/code]
